name: Freshdesk
description: Typed Freshdesk API v2 tickets, replies, private notes, contacts, companies, agents, groups, fields, search and knowledgebase.

permissions.description: Bounded HTTPS API v2 to one canonical tenant.freshdesk.com origin using an external API key; explicit write/customer-contact guards. No live provider verification, custom CNAMEs, pagination loops, listeners or credential refresh.

Canonical origin only; no custom domains, redirects, automatic pagination/retry, arbitrary proxy, attachments uploads/downloads, webhook listener or token refresh. Builtin config.$connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey; otherwise synchronous/await-compatible context.secrets.get(apiKeySecret or FRESHDESK_API_KEY). Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="FRESHDESK CREATE-TICKET", retries=0. Requires confirmCustomerContact=true; sends or may notify a customer. One explicit page; lists default to provider defaults up to 100; metadata/autocomplete lists bounded to 1000. Numeric IDs use lossless decimal strings and serialize as JSON numbers in bodies. Noninteger/unsafe JSON numbers retain lexical strings in numeric/custom-value fields. Unknown response fields are projected away. Total deadline begins before profile lookup and cannot be extended by profiles; successful stream cancellation is awaited. API-key agent role, endpoint plan, account rate limits and provider validation remain authoritative. Sources: https://developers.freshdesk.com/api/

definitions.name: Freshdesk Create Contact
definitions.documentation: POST https://{tenant}.freshdesk.com/api/v2/contacts. External API key Basic authentication. Canonical origin only; no custom domains, redirects, automatic pagination/retry, arbitrary proxy, attachments uploads/downloads, webhook listener or token refresh. Builtin config.$connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey; otherwise synchronous/await-compatible context.secrets.get(apiKeySecret or FRESHDESK_API_KEY). Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="FRESHDESK CREATE-CONTACT", retries=0. One explicit page; lists default to provider defaults up to 100; metadata/autocomplete lists bounded to 1000. Numeric IDs use lossless decimal strings and serialize as JSON numbers in bodies. Noninteger/unsafe JSON numbers retain lexical strings in numeric/custom-value fields. Unknown response fields are projected away. Total deadline begins before profile lookup and cannot be extended by profiles; successful stream cancellation is awaited. API-key agent role, endpoint plan, account rate limits and provider validation remain authoritative. Sources: https://developers.freshdesk.com/api/
